account: Huazhong University of Science and Technology developed an AI system that locates points on a learner's lips, compares the lip shapes with standard shapes, scores them and gives feedback. Xinhua photographed a deaf child using the system at the Hubei Provincial Rehabilitation Center for Deaf Children on 19 September 2024. It reported that the university's Jinchanzi volunteer team had served more than 300 hearing-impaired people since 2021, and it did not report restored speech. In its account for the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), with information current as of June 2025, the university reports that 343 deaf users regained speech capabilities with AI-guided lip-reading practice and claims threefold learning efficiency. The ITU account provides no independent confirmation of those aggregate results or of how long the restored speech lasted. Hubei Daily reported on 10 July 2025 that team volunteers recall two deaf brothers in Zhaotong, Yunnan, who said their first words after volunteers spent an afternoon teaching them with the system. No source separates the system's share of any speech gains from the volunteers' teaching.
